doctrine: Orbital is the primary operator surface.
Orbital should become voice-native: Lenox talks, Alfred directs, Orbital operates.
Field Guide is the intended living documentation layer, but Swarm retrieval is not confirmed until THI-56 is complete.
Arsenal is the skill-pack catalog; Armory still needs source confirmation.
Swarm owns coordination, trace IDs and handoffs.
Third-party tools are provider adapters behind Orbital, not places the operator must live.
Production changes require Linear and Librarian documentation.
